title: 4.12 Tomorrow and the Week
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
goal: Say what day tomorrow is, name a week, the weekend, a month and a year on a calendar, and say what you are doing now.
grammar_function: Tomorrow is + day; It is a week / the weekend / a month / a year; There are + number + days/months + in a week/year; I am / He is / They are + action + now.
prerequisite: 1.x actions; 2.6-2.7 and 3.x numbers to twelve; 3.2-3.3 I am + action; 4.4 there are; 4.9 the days and Today is + day.
speaking_outcome: Say Tomorrow is Tuesday., It is the weekend., There are seven days in a week. and I am reading now.
